policy.rules: At completed M15 close >=0.75R propose half-profit at NEXT bar open; >=1.0R tighten stop to OANDA entry effective next bar; at entry-plan expiry review thesis and EXIT next bar open only if adverse, else HOLD. Fixed-stop/TP baseline identical; both require post-entry completed bars.
policy.validation: No live advice or automatic promotion; >=30 paired independent pair-days and both positive and negative cases required even to consider further review.
